review: Exercise 1: The format example '(예: 14:00)' is the same as the correct answer '14:00', so learners can copy it without reading the notice. Change the example to a time that is not in either notice (e.g. '예: 08:00') or use a hint like '예: 00:00'.

Notice B 사유 / Exercise 2 answer: '전기설비 점검에 따른 단전' gives the outage (단전) as the reason for the outage. 사유 should say why, so change it to '전기설비 정기 점검' or similar and update the exercise 2 answer to match.

Notice B contradicts itself: 장소 limits the outage to '102동 1층~10층 공용부' (shared areas only), but 유의사항 tells residents to unplug their home appliances. Change 장소 to something like '102동 1층~10층 전체 세대', or change 유의사항 to fit a shared-area outage (e.g. '단전 시간에는 엘리베이터를 이용할 수 없습니다').

Notice B 유의사항 / Exercise 4 answer: The notice mixes 단전 and 정전, but 정전 is never taught in the word list, so high-beginner learners have to copy an unlearned word. Change it to '단전 전에 가전제품 플러그를 뽑아 주세요.' or add 정전 to the word list.

The exercises do not match the objective: no question asks for a date (일시 date/weekday), and four target words (점검, 작업, 단수, 단전) are never practised. Add a date question (e.g. '공지 B의 단전은 며칠 무슨 요일입니까?') plus a question using 작업 or a word-to-meaning matching item.

fixes.problem: "practica encontrando" copies the English "practice finding" word for word and sounds unnatural in Spanish. Spanish doesn't put a gerund after "practicar" to mean practising a skill.
fixes.fix: Lee dos avisos cortos de un edificio de apartamentos (corte de agua y corte de electricidad) y practica cómo encontrar la fecha, la hora, el lugar, el motivo y lo que deben hacer los residentes.

fixes.problem: "高级" usually means "advanced level", so "初级(高级)" reads as "Beginner (advanced)" and contradicts itself. The English means the upper part of the beginner level.
The English gloss has two meanings, "inquiries, contact", but the Japanese omits "contact" (連絡先).
fixes.fix: 문의(ムニ):問い合わせ、連絡先(電話番号、事務所)
